title: ADR Index and Its Management Commands

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given adrCandidates across a phase's step outputs, When the index is built, Then decisions/adr-index.json lists each candidate with the task that raised it and whether it was promoted.
Given the index, When a candidate is promoted to a numbered ADR, Then the index records the ADR path and the candidate is no longer listed as outstanding.
Given the adr/ and decisions/ directories, When this task completes, Then the split between them is settled and recorded, and nit:init creates only what it uses.
Given the index schema, When it is added, Then something reads every field it declares, proven by test (ADR-0007).
